implementation_summary: DEC-005 correction: the Proposal AuditDoc now takes its language from the requested language (lookup.requested ?? lookup.language) instead of the resolved fallback. The template lookup still uses lookup.language. Added a test that a Proposal requested in 'hi' has doc.language 'hi' and renders with 'Beta translation' and lang="en". Matches BE-505 pitch/owner behavior.

tests_executed.name: packages/core/tests/audit-doc-export.test.ts (31 tests, incl. new DEC-005 Proposal fallback test)

evidence: packages/core/tests/audit-doc-export.test.ts: 'a Proposal requested in a fallback language keeps the requested language and shows the beta note (DEC-005)'
risks: The new test was not run against the unfixed code to confirm it fails before the fix; by inspection it would fail on doc.language ('en' vs 'hi').

Proposal AuditDoc.language for 'hi' (and other fallback languages) is now the requested code while the content is English; consumers that use doc.language to pick a font or direction (documentDirection) get the requested language's direction, which is ltr for hi. Reviewer should check RTL languages such as 'ur' in the renderers.
pnpm build not run; no types or exported APIs changed.
handoff: Proposal docs now match structure, content, findings, roadmap, pitch and owner builders on doc.language = requested language. QA-711 can re-verify DEC-005 for the Proposal. The renderers add the beta note for fallback languages and keep lang=en. Only the one-line change and the new test were made; other tests in the file were not changed.
